annotations.title: Keep a stopped phone number from Cosend

description: Keeps a phone number from Cosend that was stopped, named by id (cnm_…), before its last day (release_at), and returns it ready: it is not given back, and from the plan’s next renewal it is billed with the plan again, at $5.95 a month, or $59.50 a year when the plan is billed yearly. Nothing is charged today. It acts only on a confirmed call: without confirmation_token it changes nothing and returns a preview of the number and a token for a person to approve; the number’s status, last day and WhatsApp connection are read again when the token comes back. Only a person’s approval keeps it. On a paid plan, for owners and admins.

confirmation_token.description: For a call that needs approval: left out, the call does nothing and returns a preview and a token; given that token, with the same arguments, the call does it.

id.description: The stopped Cosend number (cnm_…) to keep.
